{{Quote|Or the Great ''Life Jewels'' of the ''Red Nebula''. This very ship is part of a mission to retrieve ''them''. Our mistress wants them because they create a plague when separated. But legend says that together they can ''restore life''. They can be a great weapon or a great source of healing, depending on their wielder.''"<br />"''Where are these jewels now?''"<br />"''The jewels were set adrift in the Unknown Regions long ago, but with the rare durasteel on board, we can safely transport them back to the galactic core.|[[FR-D 8T-KA]] and [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]]|<ref name="SW108" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] organized a '''mission''' to retrieve the [[Great Life Jewels]], which were stored aboard an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] set adrift in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
